authority: Execution companion to mv_stage_registry.json and mv_resume_contract.json. It defines HOW the current stage is executed after Runtime has defined WHAT stage is current.

S00_SLOT_CREATED.dependency_policy: NO_NEW_DEPENDENCY. Read/refresh the existing Core Benchmark Data Center. Public search is supplemental only.
S00_SLOT_CREATED.fallback_policy: BLOCK if Core Data Center truth is unavailable; do not replace it with broad web-wide song discovery.

S01_HG01_SONG_LOCKED.dependency_policy: Reuse verified Douyin resolver/download/fingerprint paths already available in the environment or historical validated workflows. Do not add a song-specific workflow to core Runtime merely to probe one asset.
S01_HG01_SONG_LOCKED.fallback_policy: Follow mv_bgm_discovery.md priority ladder; insufficient version evidence = BGM_VERSION_DISCOVERY_BLOCKED.

S02_HG02_BGM_LOCKED.dependency_policy: Run bootstrap_alignment_env.py doctor first. Reuse locked/preheated environment. Missing engine/model = AUDIO_ALIGNMENT_RUNTIME_BLOCKED. install/preheat is a separate explicit environment action, never a per-slot default.
S02_HG02_BGM_LOCKED.fallback_policy: No waveform/BPM guessing and no ad-hoc per-song aligner. Final authority is final_gate.py validate --write-manifest.

S03_AUDIO_TIMELINE_LOCKED.dependency_policy: NO_MODEL_INSTALL. Consume canonical line_timeline, anchor_words and music_events only.
S03_AUDIO_TIMELINE_LOCKED.fallback_policy: If Audio Timeline is incomplete, return to S02/S03 prerequisite; do not infer a second lyric clock.

S04_NATURAL_BEAT_LOCKED.dependency_policy: NO_NEW_MODEL. Director reasoning is performed from locked audio/beat truth and current creative brief.
S04_NATURAL_BEAT_LOCKED.allowed_experiment_scope: Director Thesis, Primary Visual Engine, audiovisual relationship, motive-first camera-subject-space, WHY CUT HERE, optional-element stop conditions.
S04_NATURAL_BEAT_LOCKED.fallback_policy: If an OSS suggestion conflicts with lyric-hit priority or Runtime truth, keep R3.

S05_DIRECTOR_PLAN_LOCKED.dependency_policy: Use the already available image-generation capability. Do not build or install a new image backend inside Runtime for a normal MV.
S05_DIRECTOR_PLAN_LOCKED.allowed_experiment_scope: Creative Drift QA from Director to K0 and first-frame performability; do not replace HG03.
S05_DIRECTOR_PLAN_LOCKED.fallback_policy: Missing generation capability blocks asset production; it does not authorize a new backend implementation.

S06_HG03_FIRST_FRAMES_LOCKED.dependency_policy: NO_MODEL_INSTALL. Accepted K0 pixels are authority; create bounded prompts for the already selected external generator.
S06_HG03_FIRST_FRAMES_LOCKED.allowed_experiment_scope: Motive-first camera grammar, montage reason, stop conditions, Creative Drift QA.
S06_HG03_FIRST_FRAMES_LOCKED.fallback_policy: If prompt conflicts with K0, rewrite prompt around K0; do not reconstruct abandoned prose.

S07_DYNAMIC_PROMPT_SET_READY.dependency_policy: Use the already chosen Seedance/Doubao generation capability. Do not add a new generator SDK/backend during a normal slot unless generator integration itself is the approved experiment.
S07_DYNAMIC_PROMPT_SET_READY.allowed_experiment_scope: Director/montage prompt grammar only; H3/RunningHub orchestration remains out of scope.
S07_DYNAMIC_PROMPT_SET_READY.fallback_policy: TRIM BEFORE REGENERATE; local source failure stays local.

S08_DYNAMIC_SOURCE_QA_LOCKED.dependency_policy: Check ffmpeg/ffprobe availability first. Missing media tooling = BLOCK or use an already available equivalent rendering capability; do not introduce a new media library ad hoc.
S08_DYNAMIC_SOURCE_QA_LOCKED.fallback_policy: Preserve raw source; derive clean proxies. WEB watermark-safe geometry is a Gate, not optional polish.

S09_SOURCE_NORMALIZATION_READY.dependency_policy: Revalidate current BGM/package identity; never realign or create a new lyric clock here.
S09_SOURCE_NORMALIZATION_READY.fallback_policy: Mismatch returns to Audio Timeline prerequisite.

S10_EDITOR_AUDIO_GATE_PASS.dependency_policy: NO_NEW_MODEL. Build the edit map from the three locked clocks and normalized sources.
S10_EDITOR_AUDIO_GATE_PASS.allowed_experiment_scope: WHY CUT HERE / montage quality can be evaluated without changing audio truth or source eligibility.
S10_EDITOR_AUDIO_GATE_PASS.fallback_policy: Fragmentation failure patches Edit Map first, not upstream generation.

S11_EDIT_MAP_LOCKED.dependency_policy: Use existing render capability/tooling. Do not redesign the edit engine at HG04 preparation.
S11_EDIT_MAP_LOCKED.allowed_experiment_scope: Evaluate montage/edit flow, not renderer implementation.
S11_EDIT_MAP_LOCKED.fallback_policy: Technical render failure patches renderer/transform only; rhythm failure patches S11 Edit Map.

system_dependencies: subtitle renderer or existing media render capability
S12_HG04_PICTURE_EDIT_PASS.dependency_policy: Reuse the accepted subtitle baseline. Missing renderer capability blocks implementation; it does not reopen style exploration or authorize a new model.

S13_SUBTITLE_IMPLEMENTATION_QA_PASS.dependency_policy: No new AI model. Validate final codec/duration/audio/SAR/watermark/subtitle/delivery truth with existing media tooling.
S13_SUBTITLE_IMPLEMENTATION_QA_PASS.fallback_policy: Technical defect patches nearest implementation layer; do not reopen accepted aesthetic Gates unless pixels/timing materially change.

S14_FINAL_TECH_QA_PASS.dependency_policy: Use RECORD_HUMAN_GATE with fresh Canonical guard, then separate ADVANCE after user acceptance.
S14_FINAL_TECH_QA_PASS.fallback_policy: No chat-only PASS and no direct state edit.

S15_HG05_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_PASS.dependency_policy: NO_NEW_MODEL. Build release metadata from accepted render and locked account packaging rules.
S15_HG05_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_PASS.fallback_policy: Packaging issue patches release package only.

S16_RELEASE_PACKAGE_READY.dependency_policy: Requires explicit real-world publication confirmation. PUBLISH_SYNC is transactional; do not emulate with manual tracker/state edits.
S16_RELEASE_PACKAGE_READY.fallback_policy: Sync failure rolls back/blocks; never leave half-updated tracker/state.

S17_PUBLISHED_DATA_COLLECTION_ACTIVE.dependency_policy: NO_NEW_MODEL. Use actual observed metrics/checkpoint timestamps only; unknown remains unknown.
S17_PUBLISHED_DATA_COLLECTION_ACTIVE.fallback_policy: Missing metrics do not get invented; keep collection active until a valid review can be written.

S18_POST_PUBLISH_REVIEWED.dependency_policy: No execution. Preserve durable evidence and resume/allocate another slot.
